recentItems.title: OIL APOCALYPSE IN THE MOSCOW REGION: more than 50% of Russia’s refining capacity destroyed
recentItems.description:
The largest oil depot in the Moscow region is ablaze, while systematic strikes by Ukraine’s Defence Forces have already knocked out more than 50% of Russia’s oil-refining capacity, crippling fuel supplies to the Russian military.

On the front line, Ukrainian defenders have liberated around 10 square kilometres of forest in the Kharkiv region and repel hundreds of enemy assaults every day, exhausting the invaders’ manpower and equipment.

In response to its battlefield defeats, Russia launched a wave of 137 drones against peaceful cities overnight. Hospitals and residential buildings were damaged in Kyiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kryvyi Rih and Kramatorsk. There are deaths and injuries.

0:00 — Intro
0:10 — Fire at the Volodarska oil depot near Moscow and the state of Russia’s oil-refining industry
1:02 — Liberation of 10 km² of forest near Vovchansk and the disruption of the occupiers’ plans
2:41 — Russian army losses and Dutch assistance with F-16 fighter jets
4:27 — Overnight drone attack and another scramble of fighter jets in Romania
5:57 — Strikes on a civilian vessel in the Black Sea, as well as on Zaporizhzhia and Kryvyi Rih
7:29 — FPV drone strikes on Kramatorsk and the dangerous evacuation by the “White Angel” team

recentItems.title: 456 RUSSIAN ENERGY FACILITIES BURNED! Ukraine’s Security Service HITS SU-34 & SU-35 jets IN ADYGEA
recentItems.description:
As part of Operation “Crimean Switch-Off,” Ukraine’s Defence Forces struck 456 energy facilities in Russia and in the occupied territories over a three-month period, paralysing the enemy’s military logistics and repair bases.

At the same time, Ukrainian defenders carried out two successful offensive operations, driving Russian forces from important positions and taking control of key heights.

In addition, Germany announced a new military aid package worth more than €1 billion to fund interceptor drones, long-range weapons and support for Ukraine’s energy sector.

recentItems.title: KREMLIN sets NUCLEAR APOCALYPSE DATE?! Artificial crisis around Baltics as a pretext for war?
recentItems.description:
The Kremlin is spinning the nuclear roulette wheel once again, threatening the security of the entire planet! During the latest meeting of the Valdai Discussion Club, Moscow issued an overt and unprecedented ultimatum to the Western world — one that mainstream media often try to downplay: either Europe capitulates to the dictator’s imperial ambitions, or strategic flashpoints such as Kaliningrad and the Balkans become direct triggers for a Third World War!

While the international community debates the risks of artificial intelligence, a real existential catastrophe is returning to the negotiating table — the nuclear button has ended up in the hands of Stalinist revanchists in the corridors of the Kremlin.

recentItems.title: UAVs from Iran, North Korean soldiers and Taliban among guests: the final chapter of a superpower!
recentItems.description:
Ukraine has successfully tested its own tactical ballistic missile, while Security Service of Ukraine operatives destroyed two enemy fighter jets and a Buk air-defence system.

On the international stage, Kremlin diplomacy has declined from membership in the G8 to an alliance with the Taliban and North Korea.

At the same time, the enemy’s fuel system has suffered a devastating blow: according to the Ministry of Defence of Ukraine, more than 50% of Russia’s oil-refining industry has been put out of action, causing a critical collapse in logistics and the economy.
